description: OMENZ Weather: forecast for any coordinates on Earth, shaped for agents. Now (temp C/F, wind, humidity, cloud, pressure, condition), next 6h and 24h (high/low, rain total, max wind), up to a 5-day outlook, and yes/no flags to branch on: rain_next_6h, freezing_next_24h, high_wind_next_24h, heat_next_24h. Source: MET Norway (Norwegian Meteorological Institute), cached responsibly. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/weather, $0.002 via x402.)
